summary: Iteration 13 both-tested: (A) VIP big-tipper customers on serve.tsx, (B) Daily-goal claim streak bonus (backend), (C) Home 🎁 reminder badge + 🔥 streak chip + coin delta on claim. BACKEND: created /app/backend/tests/test_streak_bonus.py (7 pytest tests) — 7/7 PASSED covering (i) GET /daily-goal exposes 'streak' field default 0, (ii) claim under target -> 400 'Goal not complete', (iii) first-ever claim returns {reward=base+20, base_reward, streak_bonus=20, streak=1, player} and player.coins += reward, (iv) second same-day claim -> 400 'Already claimed', (v) DB-seeded 4-streak + last_claim=yesterday -> new streak=5 bonus=100, (vi) streak capped at 7 -> bonus max 140 (streak=21 still gives +140), (vii) gap>1 day resets streak to 1 bonus 20. FRONTEND: Primed player via API to today's goal (special3, target 3, base 150) then loaded Home — CLAIM button + play-goal-badge (🎁) both visible; goal-streak chip absent (streak=0). Tapped claim-goal-button — transient '+170 🪙 claimed! (+20 🔥 streak)' text rendered, play-goal-badge disappeared, goal-streak chip '🔥 1-day streak' appeared, top-bar coin balance went 100 → 270 (matches base 150 + streak bonus 20 exactly). VIP customers: 2/20 reloads of /serve?dishId=american_hoagie showed vip-tag (~10% expected). Caught a VIP, measured patience-bar drain rate = 0.160/s vs expected VIP ~0.157/s (normal ~0.094/s at level 5) — CLEARLY faster. Perfect-serve feedback contained '💎 VIP double tip!' and tip was doubled (+194 🪙 with 6 🔔).

_daily_goal_view returns 'streak' (from doc.goal_streak, default 0) so GET /daily-goal is complete.

serve.tsx:71-99 buildCustomers rolls isVip with p=0.1 BEFORE choosing fan/special (VIPs excluded from those); vip flag stored on Customer; patience effect (line 222) uses patienceMs*0.6 only when current.vip — verified 0.160/s vs ~0.094/s normal.
serve.tsx:313-326 handleServe perfect branch applies vipMult=2 to both coin tip and bell tip and appends '💎 VIP double tip!' to feedback text; non-VIP path is unaffected — verified in browser.
index.tsx:329-333 play-goal-badge only renders when goal?.claimable is truthy — verified appears when claimable, disappears after successful claim.
index.tsx:249-258 streak chip renders when goal.streak > 0 with '+X bonus today!' hint only when claimable — behavior consistent with spec.
index.tsx:78-89 handleClaimGoal correctly updates player from response, sets +reward claimed message with streak-bonus suffix, and re-fetches daily-goal to refresh streak chip.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (VIP tag, VIP tip doubling, faster VIP patience, claim button, play-goal-badge, goal-streak chip, coin delta all verified)
